title: Simplify Dense Coastline
description:
A GIS analyst has a table of coastline segments with very high vertex density — too detailed for small-scale map rendering. They want to simplify each segment and compare the vertex count before and after.

Goal

Return segment_name, points_before (vertex count of the original), and points_after (vertex count after simplifying with a tolerance of 2.0), ordered by segment_name.

Example Output

segment_name   points_before  points_after
-------------  -------------  ------------
North Coast    6              2
South Cove     5              3
schema:
Table: coastlines

ColumnTypeDescription
segment_nameVARCHARName of coastline segment
geomGEOMETRYLineString geometry (many vertices)

ST_NPoints(geom) counts the number of vertices. ST_Simplify(geom, tolerance) uses the Douglas-Peucker algorithm to reduce vertex count while preserving overall shape.
hints:
💡 Hint 1 Apply ST_NPoints twice: once on the original geom and once on ST_Simplify(geom, 2.0).
💡 Hint 2 You can use both in the same SELECT — no subquery needed.
starterCode:
LOAD spatial;

-- Return vertex counts before and after simplifying with tolerance 2.0.
-- Return: segment_name, points_before, points_after ordered by segment_name
SELECT
  segment_name,

FROM coastlines
ORDER BY segment_name;
